Sophie: Quick postmortem follow-up from the storage-cache spike (2026-03-20). Putting the action items here — pls confirm owners + JIRA links. Short list:
```
A1: Investigate cache eviction pattern & add telemetry -> owner?
A2: Improve graceful fallback onto CPU variant -> owner?
A3: Document runbook for prefix/KV caching behavior -> owner?
A4: Add long-tail latency test to nightly perf -> owner?
```
Prefer owners by EOD Tue. @carla @nate @ying

Carla: I can take A1 and will create a ticket now.

Nate: I'll own A2. Rough estimate: 2wks for prototype + canary.

Ying: I'll take A3 and A4. I'll coordinate with eng-infra for the nightly job.

Sophie: thanks — once tickets exist pls paste links here and add due dates. Also please add a mini RACI to each ticket (who's R/A/C/I).

Carla: RED-8021 https://jira.internal/redwood/browse/RED-8021 — assignee Carla M, due 2026-04-05. Notes: capture eviction traces, add sampling hook, spike to classify eviction triggers. R: Carla, A: Nate, C: eng-infra, I: product.

Nate: RED-8022 https://jira.internal/redwood/browse/RED-8022 — assignee Nate R, due 2026-04-10. Plan: implement CPU fallback path, add canary policy + rollback checklist. PR stub: github.com/redwood/serving/pull/487

Ying: RED-8023 https://jira.internal/redwood/browse/RED-8023 (runbook) and RED-8024 https://jira.internal/redwood/browse/RED-8024 (nightly perf job). Assigning Ying C. Will add RACI in descriptions and link runbook to ops docs.

sre-bot: Reminder: postmortem owner cadence check-in scheduled Thu 2026-03-25 10:00 PT — /remind set.

Sophie: great progress. A couple of followups: 1) please cross-reference any prior incidents that look similar, 2) list rollback steps in RED-8022, 3) if any ticket needs exec visibility ping me and I'll loop in product/CS.

Carla: added cross-ref to RED-7010 (previous cache-TTL incident) on RED-8021. Also attached eviction sample logs.

Nate: added a rollback checklist to RED-8022 and linked the PR. Will schedule a 30m pairing session with @eng-infra to validate the canary thresholds.

Ying: noted overlap with RED-7010 — I'll include cross-incident evaluation in RED-8023 and propose mitigations if pattern emerges.

Carla: question — do we want an SLA rollback play in scope for A2? Might need comms/legal signoff if customer-facing.

Nate: yes, include a rollback play. I'll draft the wording and tag @product and @legal as watchers on RED-8022.

Sophie: perfect. Final ask: when tickets hit PR-ready or doc-ready, add the :white_check_mark: reaction and update the remediation tracker spreadsheet. I'll close this thread after the Thu check-in unless anything blocks.

sre-bot: Reaction :white_check_mark: will be auto-added when ticket has both owner and due date.
